topic: What happens if you never go outside?
title: What staying inside does
hook: What happens if you never go outside?

beats.label: 1 DAY
beats.line: After a day indoors, you miss sunlight, the main signal for your body clock.

beats.label: 1 WEEK
beats.line: After a week, your skin makes no new vitamin D without sunlight.

beats.label: 2 WEEKS
beats.line: By two weeks, your sleep can start drifting later and later.

beats.label: 1 MONTH
beats.line: After a month, your vitamin D can drop, and you may feel tired.

beats.label: 2 MONTHS
beats.line: After two months, less daylight can drag your mood down.

end.line: So, how much time outside did you get today?

description: A realistic look at what months without sunlight can do to sleep, vitamin D and mood.

facts.claim: Light is the main signal that sets the body's internal (circadian) clock.
Skin makes vitamin D from UVB sunlight; window glass blocks UVB, so indoor light makes none.
Without daylight the body clock tends to drift later, delaying sleep.
Vitamin D levels fall over weeks to months without sun or diet; low levels are linked to fatigue.
Less daylight is linked to lower mood (e.g. seasonal pattern).
